faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your first session
faq.q1: Do I need previous meditation experience?
faq.a1: No. Sessions are accessible to everyone, regardless of experience. You only need to arrive with an open mind and willingness to experience.
faq.q2: What should I wear to the session?
faq.a2: Comfortable, loose clothing. We provide a blanket, pillow, and eye mask. You don't need to bring anything special.
faq.q3: How often should I have sessions?
faq.a3: For optimal results, I recommend starting with weekly sessions during the first month, then spacing them according to your needs. Many clients enjoy a monthly session as a maintenance practice.
faq.a4: Breathwork has contraindications. Please inform about medical conditions (pregnancy, heart conditions, epilepsy) before the session. I always adapt techniques to each person.
faq.q5: Can I combine these therapies with medical treatments?
faq.a5: Yes. These therapies are complementary and do not replace medical treatment. Many health professionals recommend sound healing as a therapeutic complement.
faq.a6: I currently offer in-person sessions. Online breathwork sessions are available upon consultation.
faq.a7: You can cancel or reschedule with 24 hours notice at no cost. Late cancellations may require payment of 50% of the session fee.
